(18:02) gp > box_muller() = {
  my(u1, u2, r, theta);
  u1 = random(1.0);
  u2 = random(1.0);
  r = sqrt(-2 * log(u1));
  theta = 2 * Pi * u2;
  [r * cos(theta), r * sin(theta)]
}
%1750 = ()->my(u1,u2,r,theta);u1=random(1.0);u2=random(1.0);r=sqrt(-2*log(u1));theta=2*Pi*u2;[r*cos(theta),r*sin(theta)]
(18:02) gp >
(18:02) gp > simulate_log_mass(N, mu, sigma) = {
  my(v, i, pair);
  v = vector(N);
  for (i=1, floor(N/2),
    pair = box_muller();
    v[2*i-1] = mu + sigma * pair[1];
    if (2*i <= N, v[2*i] = mu + sigma * pair[2]);
  );
  if (N % 2 == 1,
    pair = box_muller();
    v[N] = mu + sigma * pair[1];
  );
  v
}
%1751 = (N,mu,sigma)->my(v,i,pair);v=vector(N);for(i=1,floor(N/2),pair=box_muller();v[2*i-1]=mu+sigma*pair[1];if(2*i<=N,v[2*i]=mu+sigma*pair[2]););if(N%2==1,pair=box_muller();v[N]=mu+sigma*pair[1];);v

(18:02) gp > compute_K_theory(v) = {
  my(n = length(v), masses, sorted_masses, m0, sum_m_over_m0, sum_m0_over_m, k);
  masses = vector(n, i, 10^v[i]);
  sorted_masses = vecsort(masses);
  m0 = sorted_masses[floor((n+1)/2)];
  sum_m_over_m0 = sum(i=1, n, masses[i] / m0);
  sum_m0_over_m = sum(i=1, n, m0 / masses[i]);
  k = sum_m_over_m0 / sum_m0_over_m;
  k
}
%1752 = (v)->my(n=length(v),masses,sorted_masses,m0,sum_m_over_m0,sum_m0_over_m,k);masses=vector(n,i,10^v[i]);sorted_masses=vecsort(masses);m0=sorted_masses[floor((n+1)/2)];sum_m_over_m0=sum(i=1,n,masses[i]/m0);sum_m0_over_m=sum(i=1,n,m0/masses[i]);k=sum_m_over_m0/sum_m0_over_m;k
(18:02) gp >
(18:02) gp > compute_kurtosis(v) = {
  my(n = length(v), mean, m4, variance);
  mean = sum(i=1, n, v[i]) / n;
  m4 = sum(i=1, n, (v[i] - mean)^4) / n;
  variance = sum(i=1, n, (v[i] - mean)^2) / n;
  m4 / variance^2
}
%1753 = (v)->my(n=length(v),mean,m4,variance);mean=sum(i=1,n,v[i])/n;m4=sum(i=1,n,(v[i]-mean)^4)/n;variance=sum(i=1,n,(v[i]-mean)^2)/n;m4/variance^2

  kurtosis_sum = kurtosis_sum + kurtosis;
})
